text: CORRECTION to my earlier suite numbers: the uncontended full-suite run on QA SHA 9f17132 is 662 files passed / 1 failed, 9889 tests passed / 2 failed, 43 skipped, 341s. My earlier '9890 pass / 1 fail' came from a run overlapping a concurrent tsc. Conclusion is unchanged and now better evidenced: the ONLY failing file in any run is client/src/research/kris-launch-a/access-presentation.test.tsx, always 'Test timed out in 5000ms', never a broken assertion. It reproduces at the BASE SHA in your worktree with none of my code loaded, and across four runs of the identical tree it failed 1, 3, 5 and 2 tests while nothing outside it ever failed - the count tracks machine load, not code. Suggested fix: a per-file testTimeout on that test file (your file, not mine). Until then the fleet should treat it as a known flaky red and not read it as a regression from whichever lane runs the suite next. Branch tip now 5ab06dd; QA SHA is still 9f17132 (all commits after it are handoff docs only).
